units.source_text: 千重子出了店门，和街坊的孩子们围着折叠椅嬉戏耍闹。

en.t: Chieko came out of the shop and played noisily with the neighborhood children around the folding chairs.

units.source_text: 小孩子们对“大字”之类似乎不太在意，倒是对焰火更感兴趣。

en.t: The children did not seem to care much about things like the giant bonfire character; they were more interested in the fireworks.
